newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: DCC buys rest of Oare for 3.8 million punts.
newsitem.headline: DCC buys rest of Oare for 3.8 million punts.

text.p: Irish industrial holding company DCC Plc said on Monday it had increased its stake in holding company Oare to 100 percent from 80 percent for 3.801 million punts.
The consideration is being satisfied by 3.611 million punts in cash and loan notes and 0.190 million in DCC shares, DCC said.
Oare is a holding company for food firms Robt Roberts, Kelkin and Healthilife, and owns at 50 percent shareholding in KP (Ireland).

"This acqusition is in line with DCC's policy of buying out, over time, the minority holdings in its operating subsidiaries. It is the sixth such acquisition by DCC o a minority holding in a subsidiary company in the past nine months," DCC said.
